summary: Stereo imager for masters and buses: four bands (zero-latency Linkwitz–Riley crossovers) with the width of each from 0 to 200 % (the side against the mid, in the band), a Stereoize amount per band that adds a decorrelated copy of the mid to the side (the mono sum is untouched, so it is safe in mono), and Recover sides, which returns the side that narrowing took away to the mid through a 90 degree allpass pair so it does not comb in mono. Per-band width and correlation readings, Delta (hear only what it changes) and a gain-match reading. Use it to widen the highs, narrow and focus the lows, or fix a mix that collapses in mono.
use_for: Widen or narrow the stereo image per band while keeping the mix mono-compatible.

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between the first and the second band
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the first and second band, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It decides how much of the low end is treated as the lowest band.

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between the second and the third band (never below Crossover 1)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the second and third band.
parameters.sound: It moves the boundary between the lower and upper midrange.

parameters.name: Crossover 3
parameters.description: Between the third and the fourth band (never below Crossover 2)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the third and fourth band.
parameters.sound: It decides where the top band, which carries the air, begins.

parameters.name: Width 1
parameters.description: The first band's width: the side against the mid. 0 % is mono, 100 % as it came in, 200 % twice the side
parameters.how: Sets the width of the first band, from 0 % (mono) through 100 % (unchanged) to 200 % (twice the side signal).
parameters.sound: Lowering it makes the bass centred and solid; raising it spreads the lows, which can weaken mono playback.

parameters.name: Width 2
parameters.how: Sets the width of the second band, from 0 % (mono) to 200 %.
parameters.sound: Narrow values focus the lower midrange, wide values spread it.

parameters.name: Width 3
parameters.how: Sets the width of the third band, from 0 % (mono) to 200 %.
parameters.sound: Wider values spread the upper midrange and make vocals and guitars feel larger.

parameters.name: Width 4
parameters.how: Sets the width of the fourth band, from 0 % (mono) to 200 %.
parameters.sound: Wider values make the highs and air feel open and spacious.

parameters.name: Stereoize 1
parameters.description: Adds a decorrelated copy of the first band's mid to its side (the mono sum is not changed). 0 % off
parameters.how: Adds a decorrelated copy of the first band's centre to its sides, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A mono-like bass gains some width, while the mono sum stays the same.

parameters.name: Stereoize 2
parameters.how: Adds a decorrelated copy of the second band's centre to its sides.
parameters.sound: A narrow lower midrange sounds broader without changing in mono.

parameters.name: Stereoize 3
parameters.how: Adds a decorrelated copy of the third band's centre to its sides.
parameters.sound: A narrow upper midrange sounds more spacious without changing in mono.

parameters.name: Stereoize 4
parameters.how: Adds a decorrelated copy of the fourth band's centre to its sides.
parameters.sound: A narrow top end sounds airier and more open without changing in mono.

parameters.name: Recover sides
parameters.description: The side that narrowing takes away is returned to the mid, turned 90 degrees against it so it adds to the level without combing
parameters.how: Returns the side signal removed by narrowing to the centre, turned 90 degrees so it does not comb.
parameters.sound: The level stays fuller when a band is narrowed, instead of getting thinner.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the imager, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)
parameters.how: Adds -24 to +24 dB of gain after the imager.
parameters.sound: It matches the loudness to the untreated sound so you judge the width fairly.

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the imager changes: the output minus the input (glides over 10 ms)
parameters.how: Plays only the difference between the output and the input.
parameters.sound: You hear only what the imager changes, which shows how much width has been added or taken away.

readings.description: Side against mid in the first band, dB of energy, at the output (−100 when there is no side)
The second band's side against mid
The third band's side against mid
The fourth band's side against mid
Correlation of left and right in the first band at the output, −1 … +1
Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
Always 0: the imager adds no latency
